page: Amazon Web Services g6e.24xlarge is an accelerated computing instance built on the AWS Nitro hypervisor architecture. It features 96 vCPUs across 48 physical cores powered by 3.4 GHz AMD EPYC 7R13 processors, accompanied by 768 GB of DDR4 memory running at 3 GHz. For hardware acceleration, the system integrates four NVIDIA L40S GPUs based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, providing an aggregate of 179 GB of GPU memory. High-throughput local storage is included via a 3800 GB NVMe SSD, complemented by a 200 Gbps baseline network bandwidth interface.

Benchmark metrics demonstrate high throughput in machine learning inference and parallel compute tasks. In large language model evaluations, prompt processing and text generation reach the top 10% across small, medium, and 70-billion-parameter models, reaching 15.57 tokens per second on 70B models and 125.85 tokens per second on 7B models. Multi-core performance is robust, placing in the top decile for stress-ng multi-core execution (143526.67) and PassMark encryption tests (110627.4). Geekbench measurements show strong results in ray tracing (87333.0) and Clang software compilation (54520.0), alongside 92.19 million Redis SET operations per second. Single-threaded metrics remain within median ranges, reflecting standard Zen 3 per-core clock scaling.

The instance delivers high resource density by coupling 179 GB of GPU VRAM with massive local NVMe capacity and 200 Gbps networking. Although DDR4 uncached large-block memory read and write bandwidth reflects middle-tier performance, direct GPU acceleration and high-speed local NVMe storage limit host memory bottlenecks. The hardware configuration is structured for large language model inference, distributed 3D rendering and ray tracing pipelines, video transcode operations, and data-intensive analytical processing.
description: Amazon Web Services g6e.24xlarge is an accelerated computing instance designed for graphics-intensive and AI workloads. Built on the Nitro hypervisor, the platform incorporates 96 vCPUs across 48 physical cores using 3.4 GHz AMD EPYC 7R13 processors, paired with 768 GB of DDR4 system memory. Acceleration is driven by four NVIDIA L40S Ada Lovelace GPUs delivering 179 GB of total VRAM. Local high-speed storage is bundled via a 3800 GB NVMe SSD, alongside 200 Gbps baseline networking. Benchmark evaluations indicate top-tier throughput in multi-core CPU execution, PassMark encryption, and LLM inference across small, medium, and 70B models. Strong capabilities are also documented in ray tracing, Clang software compilation, and high-concurrency Redis operations. Despite mid-range single-threaded scores, the dense GPU array and high network bandwidth make this instance effective for enterprise AI inference, ray tracing, and compute-heavy media pipelines.
